catalogue: Australian residential external wall cladding and weathering components

ncc_references.relationship: Timber, fibre-cement, hardboard and structural-plywood wall-cladding context; scope limits and project conditions must be checked.

objects.name: external wall cladding system
objects.definition: The weather-exposed wall assembly outside the structural wall, including the selected boards, sheets or panels and the supports, membrane, cavity, joints, fixings, trims and flashings required by that system.
functions: Protect the wall from weather
Transfer wind actions to the wall structure
Coordinate drainage, drying, joints, openings and terminations

ncc_references.relationship: Wall-cladding structural pathways and external-wall weatherproofing context.

cad.pattern: Continuous exterior assembly over scheduled wall faces with detailed interruptions at openings, corners and junctions
cad.placement: Outside the structural wall frame or wall substrate
cad.opening: Wraps and flashes every external opening and penetration
cad.load: Weathering assembly carrying assigned face actions to the wall

notes: A material name does not supply a complete cladding system or weatherproofing result.

objects.name: direct-fixed cladding wall assembly
objects.definition: An external wall arrangement in which cladding is fixed directly to the wall frame or immediate substrate without a deliberately drained cavity behind it.
functions: Support cladding close to the frame
Transfer cladding actions directly to the structure
Weather the wall through the complete direct-fixed detail

ncc_references.relationship: Direct-fix cladding wall verification category; not a universal construction prescription.

cad.pattern: Cladding field close to and aligned with the structural support grid
cad.placement: Immediately outside framing or substrate
cad.opening: Continuity depends on complete opening and joint details

objects.name: drained-cavity cladding wall assembly
objects.definition: An external wall arrangement with a deliberate clear space between cladding and the inner water-control layer, formed by battens or furring so incidental water can drain and the rear of the cladding can dry.
functions: Create a secondary drainage path
Separate cladding from the primary water-control layer
Support ventilation or drying where the system requires it

ncc_references.relationship: Cavity-wall verification category and secondary drainage concept.

cad.pattern: Cladding field offset outward on a repeated batten or furring grid
cad.placement: Outside a continuous weather barrier with a clear drainage cavity
cad.end: Ventilated or closed upper termination as detailed
cad.opening: Cavity and membrane are flashed and drained around openings
cad.load: Cladding supported through battens or furring

notes: Cavity depth, drainage, ventilation and closures belong to a tested or documented system; the word rainscreen alone does not define them.

objects.name: timber board wall cladding assembly
objects.definition: An external cladding assembly of overlapping or interlocking timber boards fixed horizontally, vertically or diagonally with compatible supports, membrane, fixings, joints, finishes and flashings.
functions: Form a timber weathering skin
Drain water through board profile and orientation
Accommodate timber moisture movement through detailed joints and finishes

cad.pattern: Repeated full-length or jointed boards over the wall support grid
cad.placement: At the weather-exposed face of a framed wall
cad.opening: Boards stop, trim and flash around openings
cad.load: Non-structural cladding unless a separate bracing role is documented

objects.name: fibre-cement board wall cladding assembly
objects.definition: An external cladding assembly of lapped or profiled fibre-cement boards fixed to framing or battens with compatible nails or screws, joints, trims, coating and flashings.
functions: Form a durable board-format weathering skin
Transfer wind actions through repeated fixings
Drain water through laps or fitted board joints

cad.pattern: Repeated board courses or vertical runs on studs or battens
cad.placement: At the external wall face
cad.opening: Cut, fixed, sealed and flashed around openings
cad.load: Board cladding carrying face actions to supports

objects.name: exterior hardboard cladding-board assembly
objects.definition: An external wall cladding assembly of exterior-grade hardboard boards installed with the specified laps or fitted joints, fixings, expansion details, coatings and flashings.
functions: Form a lightweight board cladding skin
Shed water through board laps or profiles
Accommodate product movement at joints and terminations

cad.pattern: Repeated lapped or joined boards over wall supports
cad.placement: At the external wall face
cad.opening: Boards terminate at flashed openings
cad.load: Board cladding carrying face actions to supports

objects.name: fibre-cement sheet wall cladding assembly
objects.definition: An external wall cladding assembly of fibre-cement sheets or panels fixed on an edge and field grid with compatible joints, backing, sealants or trims, coatings and flashings.
functions: Form a sheet-format external weathering surface
Transfer face actions through edge and field fixings
Coordinate sealed, flashed or expressed sheet joints

cad.pattern: Rectangular sheet modules with edge, field and joint set-out
cad.placement: Direct to framing or over a cavity batten grid
cad.opening: Sheet grid is trimmed and flashed around openings
cad.load: Sheet cladding carrying face actions to supports

objects.name: exterior hardboard sheet wall cladding assembly
objects.definition: An external cladding assembly of exterior-grade hardboard sheets fixed to a support grid with compatible joiners, movement gaps, coatings and opening flashings.
functions: Form a sheet-format external surface
Transfer face actions through sheet fixings
Accommodate movement at detailed sheet joints

cad.pattern: Rectangular sheet modules on wall supports
cad.placement: At the external wall face
cad.opening: Sheets stop and flash around openings
cad.load: Sheet cladding carrying face actions to supports

objects.name: structural plywood wall cladding assembly
objects.definition: An external wall assembly of structural plywood sheets fixed to framing or battens with detailed edge support, movement joints, weathering finish and flashings; any structural bracing role is separately scheduled.
functions: Form an external sheet cladding surface
Transfer face actions to supports
Provide structural bracing only where the separate structural fixing schedule qualifies it

cad.pattern: Rectangular plywood sheets with supported edges and scheduled gaps
cad.placement: At the external face of framed walls
cad.opening: Sheets are cut and supported around openings
cad.load: Cladding role; structural bracing only when separately designed

objects.name: solid metal sheet wall cladding assembly
objects.definition: A wall cladding assembly of solid profiled or formed metal sheets fixed to girts, battens or other immediate supports with compatible laps, clips or fasteners, flashings and closures.
functions: Form a lightweight metal weathering skin
Transfer wind actions through the selected fixing system
Weather joints, corners, openings and terminations with compatible metalwork

ncc_references.relationship: Solid metal wall-cladding pathway through AS 1562.1.

cad.pattern: Parallel metal sheets at nominal cover width over repeated supports
cad.placement: At the external wall face on girts, battens or framing
cad.opening: Sheets cut only around fully supported and flashed openings
cad.load: Metal cladding spanning between immediate supports

notes: The AS 1562.1 pathway does not automatically cover laminated or composite metal panels.

objects.name: reinforced AAC panel external wall assembly
objects.definition: A supplied external wall system of reinforced autoclaved aerated concrete panels, supports or fixings, panel joints, coatings, flashings and movement details installed to a documented system.
functions: Form a solid lightweight external wall skin
Transfer panel self-weight and face actions through system fixings
Weather the wall through coated panels, sealed joints and flashings

ncc_references.relationship: Reinforced AAC wall-cladding pathway through AS 5146.1.

cad.pattern: Large reinforced panels placed in documented orientation with repeated fixing and sealed joint lines
cad.placement: Outside or integrated with the structural wall frame according to the supplied system
cad.opening: Panels and reinforcement are cut only where the supplied system permits and details
cad.load: Reinforced panel system with project-specific support actions

notes: The catalogue identifies the system family but does not infer panel reinforcement, cutting permission or proprietary fixing geometry.

objects.name: external eaves and soffit lining assembly
objects.definition: The external underside lining below eaves, overhangs or similar sheltered projections, including sheets, trimmers or framing supports, fixings, joints, vents and perimeter trims.
functions: Close and finish the underside of the eaves
Protect concealed roof-edge construction
Coordinate ventilation, joints and cladding junctions

cad.pattern: Sheet modules below the eaves supported by repeated trimmers or framing
cad.placement: Between external wall and fascia or outer eaves edge
cad.opening: Contains documented vents, lights and service penetrations
cad.load: External lining supported by soffit framing

objects.name: external wall opening flashing assembly
objects.definition: The coordinated head, sill and jamb flashings and seals around a window, door or other wall opening that collect and discharge water to the outside without relying on the cladding face alone.
functions: Drain water from above and around the opening
Protect opening framing and cladding cut edges
Connect the opening to the wall weather-control layers

cad.pattern: Continuous three- or four-sided weathering detail around each exposed wall opening
cad.placement: Between opening frame, structural opening, membrane and cladding
cad.end: Head drainage edge and side returns
cad.opening: Surrounds the wall opening

objects.name: cladding movement joint assembly
objects.definition: A deliberate break between cladding fields that permits specified movement and maintains weathering through a gap, flashing, backing, sealant, trim or cover arrangement.
functions: Accommodate material or building movement
Divide large cladding fields
Maintain drainage and weather protection across the break

cad.pattern: Continuous vertical or horizontal break at scheduled movement lines
cad.placement: Between independently moving cladding fields
cad.opening: Is itself a controlled gap with weathering components

objects.name: wall cladding board
objects.definition: A long narrow external cladding unit installed in repeated courses or runs with lapped, rebated, shiplap, tongue-and-groove or other detailed edges.
functions: Form one repeated unit of a board-cladding skin
Shed water through its profile and joint
Transfer face actions through board fixings

cad.pattern: Repeated parallel boards at their effective cover width
cad.placement: Across external wall supports
cad.opening: Cut and terminated around openings

objects.name: timber weatherboard
objects.definition: A timber cladding board shaped and installed to shed water as part of an overlapping or interlocking external wall covering.
functions: Form a timber wall-covering unit
Shed water across its face and lower edge
Accommodate timber movement through profile and joints

cad.pattern: Repeated board courses or runs
cad.placement: Within a timber board cladding assembly
cad.opening: Cut and sealed at openings

objects.name: splayed timber weatherboard
objects.definition: A tapered or bevelled timber weatherboard laid horizontally so the thinner upper edge sits behind the thicker lower edge of the board above.
functions: Create a lapped horizontal weathering face
Project the lower edge outward to shed water
Provide a repeated bevelled facade profile

cad.pattern: Overlapping horizontal courses with outward-thickening section
cad.placement: Across wall studs or battens
cad.opening: Courses terminate at opening trims

objects.name: rebated bevel-back timber weatherboard
objects.definition: A bevelled timber weatherboard with a machined rebate that locates or overlaps the adjacent course while retaining a sloping external face.
functions: Create a fitted horizontal weathering joint
Control course engagement and cover
Form a bevelled external profile

cad.pattern: Horizontal fitted courses with repeated rebated overlap
cad.placement: Across wall supports
cad.opening: Terminates at opening trims

objects.name: rusticated timber cladding board
objects.definition: A horizontally installed profiled timber board with a rebated or tongued joint and an expressed groove or shadow line at each course.
functions: Form a fitted horizontal timber skin
Shed water through the profiled joint
Create an expressed course line

cad.pattern: Horizontal engaged courses with an expressed groove
cad.placement: Across wall supports
cad.opening: Terminates at opening trims

objects.name: shiplap cladding board
objects.definition: A cladding board with opposing edge rebates that overlap adjacent boards to create a stepped fitted joint while allowing the boards to remain substantially in one plane.
functions: Create a rebated weathering joint
Locate adjacent boards
Form a flush or expressed board field

cad.pattern: Parallel boards engaged by opposing rebates
cad.placement: Across wall supports
cad.opening: Cut and trimmed at openings

objects.name: tongue-and-groove cladding board
objects.definition: A profiled cladding board with a projecting tongue on one edge and a matching groove on the other so adjacent boards interlock along their length.
functions: Interlock adjacent boards
Control board alignment
Form a fitted external joint in the documented orientation
materials: fibre cement or other documented board material

cad.pattern: Parallel interlocking boards
cad.placement: Across wall supports with the weather-facing edge correctly oriented
cad.opening: Cut and trimmed at openings

objects.name: fibre-cement wall cladding board
objects.definition: A long narrow fibre-cement external cladding unit formed for lapped, shiplap or another documented board joint.
functions: Form one course or run of fibre-cement cladding
Shed water through its board profile
Transfer face actions through compatible board fixings

cad.pattern: Repeated board courses or runs
cad.placement: Within a fibre-cement board cladding assembly
cad.opening: Cut, sealed and fixed around openings

objects.name: exterior hardboard wall cladding board
objects.definition: A long narrow exterior-grade wet-process fibreboard cladding unit formed for an overlapping, rebated, spline or other documented external joint.
functions: Form one course or run of hardboard cladding
Shed water through its profile
Accommodate board movement through joiners and gaps

cad.pattern: Repeated lapped or joined boards
cad.placement: Within a hardboard cladding assembly
cad.opening: Terminates at flashed openings

objects.name: wall cladding sheet
objects.definition: A broad, relatively thin external cladding unit fixed as a rectangular or profiled module to framing, battens or girts with detailed edges, joints and openings.
functions: Cover a broad wall area with one unit
Transfer face actions through edge and field supports
Form modular joints with adjacent sheets

cad.pattern: Repeated sheet modules over a support grid
cad.placement: At the external wall face
cad.opening: Cut and supported around openings

objects.name: fibre-cement wall cladding sheet
objects.definition: A flat or textured fibre-cement sheet used as one module in an external wall cladding or soffit system.
functions: Form a broad fibre-cement cladding module
Receive edge and field fixings
Provide detailed sheet edges for joints and flashings

cad.pattern: Rectangular sheet modules
cad.placement: Within a fibre-cement sheet cladding assembly
cad.opening: Cut, sealed, supported and flashed

objects.name: exterior hardboard wall cladding sheet
objects.definition: A broad exterior-grade hardboard sheet, often grooved or textured, used as one module in an external wall cladding system.
functions: Form a hardboard cladding module
Receive sheet fixings
Coordinate movement through joiners or detailed gaps

cad.pattern: Rectangular sheet modules
cad.placement: Within a hardboard sheet cladding assembly
cad.opening: Cut and flashed around openings

objects.name: structural plywood cladding sheet
objects.definition: A structural-grade plywood sheet used as an external cladding module, with its exposed edges, gaps, fixings and finish detailed for exterior service.
functions: Form a plywood cladding module
Transfer face actions through sheet fixings
Provide bracing only where its structural schedule is satisfied

cad.pattern: Rectangular plywood sheet modules
cad.placement: Within a plywood cladding assembly
cad.opening: Cut with supported and sealed edges
cad.load: Cladding sheet; possible separately documented bracing panel

objects.name: profiled metal wall cladding sheet
objects.definition: A solid metal wall sheet formed with repeated ribs, pans, corrugations or seams so it spans between wall supports and overlaps or engages adjacent sheets.
functions: Form one metal wall-cladding unit
Span between immediate wall supports
Create weathering side joints through profile geometry

cad.pattern: Parallel full-length or jointed sheets at nominal cover width
cad.placement: Over wall girts, battens or framing
cad.opening: Cut and flashed at openings
cad.load: Metal sheet spanning between wall supports

objects.name: corrugated metal wall cladding sheet
objects.definition: A solid metal wall sheet with a repeating curved corrugated profile and a side lap formed by overlapping matching corrugations.
functions: Provide a corrugated wall skin
Span between wall supports
Join adjacent sheets through corrugation overlap

cad.pattern: Parallel corrugated sheets with repeated side laps
cad.placement: On wall supports
cad.opening: Profile cut and flashed at openings

objects.name: trapezoidal-rib metal wall cladding sheet
objects.definition: A solid metal wall sheet with repeated angular ribs and pans and a side-lap detail specific to its profile.
functions: Provide an angular-rib wall skin
Span between wall supports
Join adjacent sheets through the scheduled rib lap

cad.pattern: Parallel angular-rib sheets at cover width
cad.placement: On wall supports
cad.opening: Profile cut and flashed at openings

objects.name: concealed-fixed metal wall cladding sheet
objects.definition: A solid profiled metal wall sheet shaped to engage hidden clips or interlocking seams so primary fixings are concealed behind the weathering face.
functions: Engage concealed support clips
Form a metal wall face without exposed primary fasteners
Accommodate system-specific engagement and movement

cad.pattern: Interlocking sheets over rows of concealed clips
cad.placement: On aligned wall supports
cad.opening: Clip and sheet layout is interrupted by detailed openings

objects.name: reinforced AAC external wall panel
objects.definition: A factory-made autoclaved aerated concrete wall panel containing cast-in reinforcement and installed as one unit of a documented external wall system.
functions: Form one solid wall panel unit
Span or bear between documented supports
Receive system joints, coatings, flashings and fixings

ncc_references.relationship: Panel in the reinforced AAC wall-cladding pathway.

cad.pattern: Repeated large panels with documented joint spacing
cad.placement: On the external wall support system
cad.opening: Only approved cuts and reinforced opening details
cad.load: Reinforced wall panel with system-specific support role

objects.name: cladding board lap joint
objects.definition: The overlapping interface where the lower part of one cladding board covers the upper part or thinner edge of the board below so water is shed outward.
functions: Create a gravity-shedding board joint
Set effective board cover
Keep primary fixings clear of vulnerable underlying edges

cad.pattern: Continuous joint along each overlapping course or board edge
cad.placement: Between adjacent cladding boards
cad.opening: Interrupted at board ends and openings

objects.name: cladding shiplap joint
objects.definition: The fitted stepped interface formed when opposing rebates on adjacent shiplap boards overlap each other.
functions: Locate shiplap boards
Create a weathering overlap
Allow documented movement without opening a direct path

cad.pattern: Continuous stepped interface along board edges
cad.placement: Between adjacent shiplap boards
cad.opening: Interrupted at board ends and openings

objects.name: cladding tongue-and-groove joint
objects.definition: The fitted linear interface where the tongue of one cladding board engages the groove of the adjacent board.
functions: Align adjacent boards
Restrict direct passage through the board joint
Transfer limited local edge restraint without replacing structural support

cad.pattern: Continuous interlocking interface along adjacent boards
cad.placement: Between tongue-and-groove boards
cad.opening: Interrupted at board ends and openings

objects.name: cladding board butt joint
objects.definition: The end-to-end interface between two cladding boards in the same run, supported and weathered by the specified cut, gap, joiner, flashing or seal detail.
functions: Continue a board run beyond one board length
Accommodate end movement
Weather and support exposed board ends

cad.pattern: Discrete end joints staggered or aligned according to the system
cad.placement: Between board ends on a support or approved off-support detail
cad.opening: Is a small controlled interface

objects.name: expressed cladding sheet joint
objects.definition: A deliberately visible gap between sheet or panel edges, detailed with backing, flashing, sealant or an open drained path as part of the selected cladding system.
functions: Define the sheet module visually
Accommodate sheet tolerances and movement
Maintain weathering through the joint backing or drainage detail

cad.pattern: Repeated visible lines between sheet modules
cad.placement: Between adjacent cladding sheet edges
cad.opening: Is the controlled visible gap

objects.name: cladding expansion gap
objects.definition: A deliberate clear separation between cladding units or fields sized and located so the materials or building can move without crushing, buckling or uncontrolled cracking.
functions: Provide physical movement clearance
Separate moving cladding fields
Receive backing, sealant, flashing or cover components

cad.pattern: Continuous clear gap at scheduled movement lines
cad.placement: Between cladding units or fields
cad.opening: Is itself the movement opening

objects.name: cladding joint backing strip
objects.definition: A continuous strip behind a cladding joint that blocks a direct view or water path and provides the specified backing, drainage or sealing surface.
functions: Back an expressed or butt joint
Protect the inner weather layer from direct exposure
Support sealant or provide a drained secondary path as detailed

cad.pattern: Continuous strip centred behind a joint
cad.placement: Behind adjacent cladding edges
cad.opening: Backs rather than fills the visible joint

objects.name: external cladding joint sealant
objects.definition: A compatible flexible sealant bead installed in a cladding joint or around a trim to restrict water and air entry while accommodating the specified movement.
functions: Seal a detailed external joint
Accommodate limited movement
Connect cladding edges to trims, flashings or frames

cad.pattern: Continuous bead along detailed joints and trim interfaces
cad.placement: Between prepared joint substrates over backing or bond breaker
cad.opening: Fills the designed sealant portion of a joint

objects.name: cladding joint bond-breaker tape
objects.definition: A non-bonding tape placed at the back of a sealant joint so the sealant adheres to the two side faces rather than bonding on three sides.
functions: Prevent unwanted rear sealant adhesion
Help the sealant deform in its intended shape
Separate sealant from incompatible or moving backing

cad.pattern: Continuous narrow tape behind sealant runs
cad.placement: At the rear face of a two-sided sealant joint
cad.opening: Occupies the rear interface without filling the movement gap

objects.name: cladding drainage cavity
objects.definition: The continuous clear space behind cavity-fixed cladding and outside the inner weather-control layer through which incidental water can drain and air can move where the system permits.
functions: Provide a secondary drainage path
Separate wet cladding from the inner wall
Support drying or ventilation where designed
materials: air space defined by cladding, battens and membrane

cad.pattern: Continuous void field broken by battens, flashings and permitted barriers
cad.placement: Between cladding rear face and weather barrier
cad.opening: Connects to base, top and local drainage openings as detailed

objects.name: wall cladding batten
objects.definition: A repeated secondary member fixed to the wall frame or substrate to support cladding, establish its fixing grid and, where configured, form a drainage cavity.
functions: Provide a cladding fixing substrate
Set the cladding plane and support spacing
Form a cavity or cross-batten grid where designed

cad.pattern: Repeated linear supports aligned to the cladding fixing direction
cad.placement: Between cladding and wall frame or substrate
cad.opening: Trimmed, doubled or interrupted around openings

objects.name: vertical cladding cavity batten
objects.definition: A vertical wall batten that supports horizontal or sheet cladding while preserving predominantly vertical drainage routes behind the cladding.
functions: Support cladding at repeated vertical lines
Set cavity depth
Allow water to drain between battens

cad.pattern: Repeated vertical members, usually aligned to studs or a designed support grid
cad.placement: Outside the weather barrier
cad.opening: Frames or stops around openings

objects.name: horizontal structural cladding batten
objects.definition: A horizontal secondary member designed to support vertical or diagonal cladding and transfer its actions back to the structural wall.
functions: Support vertical or diagonal cladding
Provide repeated horizontal fixing lines
Transfer cladding actions to studs or other structure
not_synonyms: blocking that seals a drainage cavity

cad.pattern: Repeated horizontal supports across the wall
cad.placement: Outside framing or over a counter-batten grid
cad.opening: Trimmed around openings and detailed to preserve drainage

notes: A plain continuous horizontal batten can obstruct cavity drainage; the system must provide a documented path around or through it.

objects.name: drained horizontal cladding batten
objects.definition: A horizontal cladding support shaped, notched, castellated or discontinuously installed so vertical water and air paths remain through the cavity.
functions: Support vertical cladding
Preserve vertical cavity drainage
Create a documented ventilated or drained cross-batten detail

cad.pattern: Horizontal supports with repeated drainage interruptions
cad.placement: Across a drained cavity behind vertical cladding
cad.opening: Repeated notches or gaps preserve vertical flow

objects.name: metal wall furring channel
objects.definition: A cold-formed metal channel or top-hat section fixed to the wall structure to align and support sheet or panel cladding away from the primary frame.
functions: Provide a straight metal fixing substrate
Set cladding offset and support grid
Transfer face actions to the wall structure

ncc_references.relationship: Immediate supporting member within a solid metal cladding system.

cad.pattern: Repeated linear metal supports perpendicular to sheet span
cad.placement: Between structural wall and metal or panel cladding
cad.opening: Trimmed and framed around openings

objects.name: external wall weather barrier
objects.definition: A pliable membrane or sarking layer installed outside the wall frame or substrate and behind cladding to form a continuous secondary water-control and air-control layer with classified vapour properties.
functions: Drain incidental water outward
Limit wind-driven air and water entry to the frame
Provide the scheduled vapour-control behaviour

cad.pattern: Continuous lapped membrane field over the external wall substrate
cad.placement: Behind cladding and cavity battens where the system specifies
cad.opening: Cut, dressed and flashed around every opening and penetration

notes: Membrane class and vapour direction are project inputs; wall wrap is not automatically a vapour barrier.

objects.name: wall weather-barrier seam tape
objects.definition: A compatible adhesive tape applied over selected laps, cuts, repairs or junctions in a wall weather barrier to maintain the documented water or air-control continuity.
functions: Seal membrane seams or repairs
Maintain water-control continuity
Maintain air-control continuity where the system requires it

cad.pattern: Continuous tape runs over designated membrane seams and repairs
cad.placement: On the exterior face of the wall weather barrier
cad.opening: Dresses around cuts and penetrations

objects.name: cladding cavity vent and closure strip
objects.definition: A perforated or slotted strip at a cavity opening that keeps the drainage or ventilation path open while limiting entry of insects, vermin or debris to the documented aperture size.
functions: Terminate the cladding cavity neatly
Permit drainage and ventilation
Screen the cavity opening

cad.pattern: Continuous screened strip along open cavity terminations
cad.placement: At the base, top or local opening of a cladding cavity
cad.opening: Contains repeated drainage and ventilation apertures

objects.name: external cladding nail
objects.definition: A corrosion-compatible nail selected to fix a cladding board or sheet through any batten and into the supporting framing with the required head, shank and penetration.
functions: Fasten cladding to its support
Transfer wind actions
Hold joints and laps without damaging the cladding
materials: stainless steel or other compatible metal

cad.pattern: Repeated at each board-support or sheet-support fixing location
cad.placement: Through cladding into a batten, stud or other support
cad.opening: Occupies a driven fixing point

objects.name: fibre-cement cladding nail
objects.definition: A corrosion-compatible nail with a head and shank selected for fixing fibre-cement boards or sheets to a suitable support without unacceptable breakout or overdriving.
functions: Fasten fibre-cement cladding
Transfer face actions
Seat the head without crushing or breaking the sheet

cad.pattern: Repeated at scheduled fibre-cement fixing points
cad.placement: Through fibre-cement board or sheet into support
cad.opening: Occupies a driven fixing point

objects.name: external cladding screw
objects.definition: A corrosion-compatible screw selected to fasten cladding, clips, trims or flashings to timber or metal supports with the required head, thread, washer and penetration.
functions: Fasten cladding or accessories
Transfer wind actions
Provide removable or controlled-head fixing where the system requires it

cad.pattern: Repeated at scheduled sheet, board, clip, trim or flashing points
cad.placement: Through the fixed component into its support
cad.opening: Occupies a formed or drilled fixing point

objects.name: concealed wall-cladding fixing clip
objects.definition: A hidden connector fixed to wall supports or engaged in a board or sheet edge so cladding is restrained without an exposed primary fastener through its face.
functions: Secure cladding from behind or at an edge
Maintain the visible face without exposed primary fixings
Permit system-specific engagement or movement

cad.pattern: Repeated hidden connectors along supports or cladding edges
cad.placement: Behind the cladding face between cladding and support
cad.opening: Engages a groove, seam or hidden edge

objects.name: wall-cladding rivet
objects.definition: A corrosion-compatible blind or solid rivet used to join thin metal cladding, flashings or trims where the selected walling system permits a riveted connection.
functions: Join thin metal components
Secure flashings or side details
Provide one-sided fastening where applicable

cad.pattern: Repeated at scheduled thin-metal connection points
cad.placement: Through overlapping metal cladding accessories or flashings
cad.opening: Occupies a drilled or punched hole

objects.name: external wall opening head flashing
objects.definition: A flashing above a window, door or other wall opening that intercepts water from the cladding or cavity above and projects or drains it to the exterior clear of the opening head.
functions: Collect water above the opening
Discharge water to the outside
Protect the opening head and framing
materials: pliable flashing membrane or documented compatible material

cad.pattern: One continuous flashing over each exposed opening head
cad.placement: Behind cladding and over the opening frame or reveal
cad.opening: Spans above and drains around the opening

objects.name: external wall opening sill flashing
objects.definition: A tray, flap or sloping flashing below a window, door or other opening that collects water from the frame and jambs and drains it outward over or through the cladding system.
functions: Collect water at the opening base
Drain water to the exterior
Protect sill framing and wall layers below
materials: pliable flashing membrane or documented compatible material

cad.pattern: One continuous tray or flap below each opening
cad.placement: Under the opening frame or reveal and behind or over the cladding drainage edge
cad.start: Beyond or turned up at one jamb
cad.end: Beyond or turned up at the other jamb
cad.opening: Forms the lower weathering boundary of the opening

objects.name: external wall opening jamb flashing
objects.definition: A vertical flashing or membrane return at the side of a wall opening that connects the frame or reveal to the wall weather barrier and directs water down to the sill flashing.
functions: Protect opening sides
Connect head and sill weathering
Direct side-entry water toward the sill drainage path

cad.pattern: One vertical flashing to each side of an exposed opening
cad.placement: Between opening frame or reveal and wall weather layers
cad.opening: Runs along the opening side

objects.name: external wall cladding corner flashing
objects.definition: A continuous folded or pliable flashing behind an internal or external cladding corner that provides a secondary weather path beneath the visible corner joint or trim.
functions: Back up the cladding corner joint
Direct water away from corner framing
Connect weather barriers around the change in wall direction

cad.pattern: Continuous vertical folded or wrapped strip at each wall corner
cad.placement: Behind cladding and visible corner trim
cad.opening: Wraps the corner rather than forming an opening

objects.name: vertical cladding joint flashing
objects.definition: A narrow vertical flashing behind a board or sheet joint that intercepts water passing the face joint and drains it downward within the wall weathering system.
functions: Back up a vertical cladding joint
Protect the weather barrier from direct exposure
Drain joint water downward
materials: UV-resistant membrane or proprietary compatible strip

cad.pattern: Continuous vertical strips behind selected joint lines
cad.placement: Behind board ends or sheet edges
cad.opening: Backs a joint opening

objects.name: horizontal inter-storey cladding flashing
objects.definition: A continuous horizontal flashing at a floor line or other cladding break that separates wall fields, drains the upper field outward and accommodates documented building or material movement.
functions: Drain the upper cladding or cavity
Separate storey-height cladding fields
Accommodate floor or frame movement at the junction

cad.pattern: Continuous horizontal line at each scheduled floor or movement break
cad.placement: Between upper and lower cladding fields
cad.opening: Creates a drained horizontal separation

objects.name: cladding base flashing
objects.definition: A continuous flashing or formed base profile at the bottom of a cladding field that terminates the weather barrier or cavity and discharges water clear of the wall below.
functions: Drain the wall weather layers at the base
Protect the lower cladding and frame edge
Create a drip or screened cavity opening

cad.pattern: Continuous horizontal termination along the cladding base
cad.placement: Below the first cladding course or panel row
cad.opening: Includes a drip or screened drainage opening

objects.name: external wall service penetration flashing
objects.definition: A collar, boot, tray or folded flashing that connects a pipe, conduit, duct, box or other wall penetration to the cladding and inner weather barrier and drains water outward.
functions: Weather the penetration perimeter
Connect cladding and membrane layers to the penetrating object
Direct water around and below the opening

cad.pattern: One complete flashing detail around each exposed service penetration
cad.placement: Between service, cladding and wall weather barrier
cad.opening: Surrounds the service opening

objects.name: external cladding corner trim
objects.definition: A visible linear profile covering or forming the junction where cladding turns around an external wall corner, installed over the system corner flashing and supports.
functions: Finish external cladding edges
Set the external corner line
Protect and seal or drain the visible corner joint as detailed

cad.pattern: Continuous vertical profile at external corners
cad.placement: Over cladding edges and corner flashing
cad.opening: Receives cladding edges on both sides

objects.name: internal cladding corner trim
objects.definition: A visible linear profile covering or forming the re-entrant junction where cladding from two wall faces meets at an internal corner.
functions: Finish internal cladding edges
Set a straight re-entrant corner
Seal or drain the visible joint over corner flashing

cad.pattern: Continuous vertical profile at internal corners
cad.placement: Between cladding edges over corner flashing
cad.opening: Receives cladding edges from both faces

objects.name: cladding stop trim
objects.definition: A linear edge profile that receives and finishes the exposed end of cladding at an opening, abutment, change of material or other termination.
functions: Finish a cladding edge
Maintain a controlled gap to the adjacent element
Provide a sealant, drip or flashing interface

cad.pattern: Continuous profile along cladding termination lines
cad.placement: At openings, abutments and material changes
cad.opening: Receives the cladding edge

objects.name: cladding board or sheet joiner
objects.definition: A purpose-made metal or plastic profile that receives adjacent cladding board ends or sheet edges and forms the documented alignment, movement and weathering joint.
functions: Align adjacent cladding units
Cover or back the joint
Provide product-specific clearance, sealing or drainage

cad.pattern: Continuous or discrete joiner at aligned cladding edges
cad.placement: Between adjacent boards or sheets
cad.opening: Receives both cladding edges

objects.name: fibre-cement eaves or soffit lining sheet
objects.definition: A fibre-cement sheet installed as the exposed underside lining of an eave, soffit or sheltered external projection.
functions: Close the underside of the eaves
Provide an external lining surface
Receive joints, fixings, vents and penetrations

cad.pattern: Rectangular sheets between wall and fascia support lines
cad.placement: On the underside of eaves or soffit framing
cad.opening: Cut and supported around vents, lights and services

objects.name: eaves soffit lining trimmer
objects.definition: A repeated or perimeter support member below the eaves that provides fixing lines for soffit sheets and frames sheet edges, joints and penetrations.
functions: Support soffit lining sheets
Frame sheet edges and joints
Transfer lining and wind actions to the roof or wall structure

cad.pattern: Repeated supports across the soffit width plus perimeter and joint framing
cad.placement: Above the soffit lining between wall and fascia
cad.opening: Additional trimming around soffit openings

objects.name: reinforced AAC panel fixing or bracket
objects.definition: A documented bracket, cleat, screw or anchor assembly that supports or restrains a reinforced AAC wall panel and transfers its actions to the structural frame or support.
functions: Support or restrain an AAC panel
Transfer panel actions to the structure
Maintain system clearances and movement details

ncc_references.relationship: System fixing within reinforced AAC wall cladding.

cad.pattern: Repeated at documented panel support and restraint points
cad.placement: Between AAC panel and structural frame or support
cad.opening: May occupy approved panel holes or edge details
cad.load: AAC panel support or restraint connector

notes: Exact fixing geometry and spacing must come from the selected supplied system and project design.

objects.name: cladding cut-edge sealer or primer
objects.definition: A compatible liquid treatment applied to freshly cut or exposed cladding edges where the product system requires sealing, priming, corrosion repair or moisture protection before installation or finishing.
functions: Protect a cut or exposed edge
Prepare the edge for coating or sealant
Restore product-system weather or corrosion protection where specified

cad.pattern: Narrow coating zone along scheduled cut or exposed edges
cad.placement: On cladding cuts, holes or damaged coating areas before closure
cad.opening: Coats the edge around cuts and penetrations

notes: Timber, fibre cement and coated metal require different compatible treatments; edge sealer is a role, not one universal product.
